key_features: 💥💥【Upgraded Since Jun 1, 2026】We've leveled up the A4! The rear camera now captures crystal-clear 2.5K footage (previously 1080P), and WiFi 6 replaces the old WiFi standard for lightning-fast video transfers to your phone. Same trusted A4 — now sharper and smarter.

【4K+2.5K UHD 2160P Dual Dash Cam】 Experience your drive in breathtaking 4K UHD resolution with a 160-degree wide-angle view for the AFFVER front dash cam, and a 2.5K resolution with a 155° wide-angle for the rear camera, providing smooth, cinematic video evidence for accident disputes and insurance claims. The perfect dash camera for family vehicles, new drivers, and Uber/Lyft drivers.

【Enhanced 5GHz WiFi 6 with APP & Built-in GPS】Upgraded to 5GHz WiFi 6 since Jun 1, 2026, this dash cam now delivers video download speeds up to 10MB/s — 25% faster than the previous generation 5GHz WiFi (8MB/s) — for faster footage transfers and smoother video review. The built-in GPS precisely tracks your driving speed, route, and real-time coordinates, with full journey playback available via the app or our Windows & Mac GPS Player.

【3.59-Inch IPS Screen & Low Profile Design】The large 3.59-inch IPS screen delivers an exceptionally clear experience. The user interface is easy to read, making menu navigation straightforward and intuitive. With its low-profile and hidden design, the A4 dash camera ensures clear driving visibility while minimally affecting your vehicle's interior.

【Seamless Loop Recording & G-sensor】Loop Recording: Minimizes memory maintenance by automatically overwriting the oldest videos when the memory card nears capacity. Gravity Sensor: Acts as an extra witness during incidents; the built-in 3-axis gravity sensor automatically locks and protects videos from deletion in the event of a serious collision, providing additional security for your recordings.

【24-Hour Parking Mode – Vehicle Safety Assurance】When the A4 is connected to the dedicated hardwire kit, it will continue recording in low FPS mode after your car is turned off and you’ve left. This feature protects your belongings and captures evidence of any malicious damage, even when you're not around. Please note that the Type-C hardwire kit is required and sold separately (ASIN: B0DCNSYCF9).

【64GB Card Included / Extra Port in Car Charger】Enjoy plug-and-play convenience with the included 64GB card—no need to buy an extra card for the A4. The lighter port charger features a USB port, letting you charge your phone or other devices while the camera records, ensuring you never lose your charging source in the car.

【Super Night Vision】Equipped with an ultra-large F1.5 aperture and a 6-layer lens that boosts light intake by 60%, this dash cam excels in low-light conditions. Enhanced by WDR (Wide Dynamic Range) technology, it automatically adjusts exposure in extremely dark settings, delivering clear, high-quality videos both day and night.

【Simplified Installation & 24-Month Warranty】The package includes essential installation tools and straightforward wiring connections, allowing your A4 dash cam to be up and running in no time! Affver offers dedicated technical support and an after-sales team to assist with any installation or usage questions. Plus, enjoy peace of mind with a 24-month warranty on your A4 dash cam.
